title: unified-rollouts-add-integration-tests-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback
author: Jordan Kim
description: Motivation: production regressions and intermittent rollouts issues highlighted gaps in end-to-end coverage for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow traffic) and automated rollback behavior. This PR adds deterministic integration tests and a CI job that exercises staged canary, weighted A/B, and shadow traffic probing with metric-driven automatic rollback, plus stability guards for flaky external metrics. Scope: 1) new integration test harness and deterministic mock traffic generator; 2) e2e tests that run through canary -> promote -> A/B -> shadow probing -> triggered rollback on metric quorum failure; 3) CI workflow and flakiness guard; 4) small fixes to the autorollback test helpers and observability hooks to make metrics deterministic in tests. Checklist: - [x] add integration test harness and fixtures - [x] implement deterministic mock metrics and traffic generator - [x] add canary/A-B/shadow end-to-end scenarios - [x] add metric quorum failure simulation and assert rollback - [x] add CI job and gating - [x] update docs and test README (rollouts/README-tests.md) Testing notes: tests run locally with the harness using seed-controlled traffic; CI job runs on a warmed staging stack and re-runs flaky steps automatically up to 2 retries. Regressions addressed: flakiness in autorollback e2e, missing observability tags that made rollouts hard to debug in CI. Impact: improves confidence in rollout safety logic and gives SREs a reproducible suite for diagnosing rollout regressions.
